review_type: Source-based full-suite consistency review; C1–C4 applied to authored data, parent regenerates outputs

findings.surface: patient monitoring, treatment map and clinician KB
findings.finding: Weekly FBC during a cytopenia-related treatment delay is present in the clinical protocol but absent from patient monitoring summaries and KB monitoring.
findings.requested_fix: Add conditional weekly blood-count monitoring while treatment is delayed for low counts; regenerate affected web/PDF/map outputs.
findings.resolution: Applied to scoped authored patient/KB/phase-support data; generated HTML/PDF verification pending parent regeneration.

findings.finding: Current KB describes order and duration but does not state irinotecan must not be administered earlier than one hour after the end of cetuximab infusion.
findings.requested_fix: Add explicit source-attributed interval to clinician administration instructions; patient appointment text may mention a planned interval without dosing instructions.
findings.resolution: Applied to scoped authored patient/KB/phase-support data; generated HTML/PDF verification pending parent regeneration.

findings.finding: Atropine notes warn against glaucoma but omit the source caution in asthma.
findings.requested_fix: Add asthma caution and clinical review to atropine notes; retain distinction between cholinergic syndrome and delayed diarrhoea.
findings.resolution: Applied to scoped authored patient/KB/phase-support data; generated HTML/PDF verification pending parent regeneration.

findings.surface: detailed patient bowel advice and distilled expectations
findings.finding: Patient text asks patients to follow their written plan and seek urgent advice for severe symptoms, but does not explicitly direct starting their supplied rescue plan and electrolyte fluids at the first liquid stool.
findings.requested_fix: State act at the first liquid stool using the individually supplied plan and fluids; contact the team early, do not wait for severe diarrhoea. Do not turn generic numeric clinician reference into an unissued patient prescription.
findings.resolution: Applied to scoped authored patient/KB/phase-support data; generated HTML/PDF verification pending parent regeneration.
